name: Annemarie Schimkat
headline: CDTM | TUM | STARTBayArea | START Munich | TUMfast
summary:
I hold a Master’s degree with a dual major in Power Engineering and Innovation from the Technical University of Munich (TUM), graduating with a 1.2 final grade (~3.8 GPA). Beyond the core curriculum, I developed technical expertise in nuclear reactor systems, with a particular focus on SMRs, Gen-IV concepts. 

I am a member of CDTM (Center for Digital Technology and Management), an elite interdisciplinary education and research program jointly run by TUM and LMU Munich, focused on bridging science, technology, and innovation. 

Always interested in conversations with researchers, innovators and operators, working on serious energy problems.

positions.title: Co-Initiator STARTBayArea
positions.description: Co-initiator of STARTBayArea, a selective exchange program that connects outstanding talent from Munich, Germany, with leading technology and innovation organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area. The program facilitates direct interaction with founders, researchers, and investors at organizations such as Google X, PsiQuantum, and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z).

positions.company: TUM Finance and Accounting Selected Talents (TUMfast)
positions.description: TUM Finance and Accounting Selected Talents (TUMfast) is a scholarship for outstanding students of the TUM School of Management interested in finance, accounting, and controlling.

positions.title: Community Member
positions.description: Being the most prominent entrepreneurial community in Munich, START offers an international network and enables members to access Munich's startup ecosystem. START connects the new generation of entrepreneurs who master future social and technological challenges. Members organize exciting events ranging from workshops to insight sessions with innovative startups, driven founders, and knowledgable investors. START alumni founded successful startups like Freeletics, IDnow, and Trade Republic and the conference Bits & Pretzels.

positions.title: Business Development
positions.description: Driving strategic growth through market analysis, lead generation, and successful deal closures. Proven expertise in smart manufacturing and digital twins. Results-driven and passionate about cultivating valuable partnerships.

positions.title: Co-Lead Partnerships Department
positions.description:
As the Co-Lead of the Partnerships Department at START Munich, I collaboratively empower a 9-member team through the intricacies of developing and executing partnerships with various companies and entities. My role encompasses both cultivating a cooperative and high-performance team culture, as well as overseeing the daily operations of the partnerships division.
I was able to successfully close partnerships with notable industry players like Google, Intel, Cisco, Celonis and Personio.

positions.title: Venture Capital Investment
positions.description: BayBG Venture Capital is a private investment company that invests in straight equity from Pre-Series A to Series B. The venture capital team has invested around €80 million in more than 60 startups over the past 15 years, including startups like NavVis and Tado.

company.name: START Munich
company.tagline: Your entrepreneurial community in Munich. From students for students.
company.description: START Munich is Munich's largest independent student initiative focused on entrepreneurship. START Munich was founded in 2003 with the goal of promoting entrepreneurship and innovation among students. The organization has 500+ members who come together to learn, network, and collaborate on entrepreneurial projects. Through a lively community, events, workshops, and active department work, START Munich helps students develop the skills and knowledge they need to turn their ideas into successful ventures. Whether you are just starting out in entrepreneurship or an experienced founder, START Munich provides a supportive and dynamic community for students to grow and succeed.
